summary.text: Jarvis Adams is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026 and faces incumbent Molly Howard (D).

paragraphs.text: Jarvis Adams was the Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 31 in 2022 and 2024. Ballotpedia reports that Molly Howard defeated him in both general elections, in 2024 by 53.5% to 46.5%.
